description: MVP of a data-collection layer that stores only what a camera+IMU rig cannot predict (corollary-discharge cancellation + residual triggering), inspired by Perks et al., Nature 2026 (doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10690-6).

datasets.description: Rendered rig: static textured scene + gyro-driven camera rotation + injected blob/bar surprise events. The primary benchmark (train/val splits, frames + imu.csv + events.json + featmaps.npy per sequence).
60-second single-scene demo used by the pixel-pipeline experiment (scripts/run_experiment.py).
Webcam field test: real camera, synthetic scene motion, no IMU (sines emulated offline). Used for the webcam readout in README.

Raw Open-AoE segment source (ant-research OpenAoE-2000h via hf-mirror): camera_traj.npz (SLAM cam_c2w), ego_action_annotation.json, undistorted mp4. Segment: aoe_20260214_232847_p000 (181 s egocentric unboxing).

Open-AoE segment converted to the standard sequence layout by scripts/prep_aoe.py: gyro derived from trajectory differentiation (sign auto-calibrated vs DIS flow), real f_map=11.49, events = active-manipulation intervals.
